study_identification.author_journal_year: Zhang et al., Brain Imaging and Behavior, 2022
study_identification.title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

study_characteristics.study_objective: To introduce an individual-level structural abnormality detection method for glioma patients, propose several abnormality indexes to depict individual atrophy patterns, and investigate whether individual frontal glioma patients display unique structural alterations, whether common patterns of structural alterations exist among glioma patients, and whether the individual-level atrophy patterns are correlated with patient-specific tumor characteristics.

dataset_name.answer: In-house dataset from Beijing Tiantan Hospital

response_variable.answer: Gray matter volume; White matter volume

predictor_effects.answer: Age, Sex, and TIV are modeled as fixed effects.

nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: The model accounts for age, sex, and TIV, which are common nuisance variables in neuroimaging.
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: General linear model (GLM) was adopted to discover the relationship between brain volume and variables including age, sex and total intracranial volume (TIV)
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.location: Page 4, Generation of individual structural abnormality map section

clinical_dataset.answer: In-house dataset from Beijing Tiantan Hospital

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Spearman correlation for continuous variables (tumor volume, CCI, MOCA score) and two-sample t-test for categorical variables (TERT mutation, 1p/19q co-deletion, MGMT promoter methylation, histological grade, IDH1).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Glioma patients showed unique non-tumoral atrophy patterns, with overlapping atrophy regions in areas related to cognitive function, and these atrophy patterns were associated with molecular biomarkers.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Every patient displayed a unique atrophy pattern. Shared atrophic regions were found in the temporal lobe (hippocampus, amygdala, parahippocampus), middle and inferior temporal gyrus, precuneus, lingual gyrus, fusiform, and insula. GM/WM relative atrophy ratio correlated with tumor size (r = -0.671 and -0.684, p < 0.0001 after excluding high-grade gliomas). WM contralateral atrophy ratio differed between IDH mutation types. WM relative atrophy ratio differed between 1p/19q co-deletion types. GM/WM relative atrophy ratios differed between TERT mutation types.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: The optimal threshold for the W-score was unclear. Sex and TIV were not well-matched between patients and controls. Perifocal edema was included in the tumor segmentation, which may have affected the results.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: The study proposed 8 novel whole-brain structural abnormality indexes to depict individualized structural atrophy patterns.

general_notes.general_notes: The study highlights the potential of individual-level structural MRI analysis for personalized assessment of glioma patients, moving beyond group-level comparisons.
